text:
Renee P.: Quick alert 1 Bishop SI toggled 'auto-assign' in the marketplace and four named accounts moved owners. Two have launch windows next week, need an immediate SLA & badge policy so partners don't auto-take.

Martin S.: Which accounts? are launches affected?

Renee P.: acct_7100 (launch 2026-05-05), acct_7101 (POC), acct_7103 (early), acct_7110 (demo).

Lena (Bishop SI): Apologies 1 we flipped auto-assign to speed onboarding. We can roll back on the launch ones. Bishop had assumed "marketplace badge = permission to own".

Diego R.: That's the core problem. Marketplace badge should not equal instant owner flip. Proposed guardrails: 1) Add an "SI_badge" field visible in SF but do not change ownership automatically. 2) SI can claim but claim goes into a "handoff_sla" queue (48h default) where partnerships & field confirm. 3) If field sets 'Redwood_lead' within SLA, revert; if no response, assign as Joint by default.

Renee P.: Also add a short audit note: who requested the change and which marketplace event triggered it. That helps postmortems.

Martin S.: Agree. For launches/PR windows require manual Partnerships ack before any owner changes. Also add a "badge_scope" enum (vertical, territory, named-list) so SIs know where the badge applies.

Lena (Bishop SI): We'll disable auto-assign and add UX copy: "Badge grants eligibility to claim, not immediate ownership. Partnerships confirmation required." We'll re-open the two launch accounts to Redwood owner.

crm-bot: Automated note appended to acct_7100 and acct_7110: "Marketplace auto-assign disabled; claim placed in handoff_sla queue (48h). Partnerships review required." :white_check_mark:

Diego R.: I'll patch the CRM rule today. Draft YAML: trigger: marketplace_claim -> actions: add_tag: "handoff_sla_pending"; set_ttl: 48h; notify: [partnerships, owner]; on_expiry: assign_joint_with_default_split.

Renee P.: Good. Lina, please also have your onboarding include the badge_scope guidance. Martin, can partnerships write a 1-page SLA + badge doc we can share with SIs?

Martin S.: On it. I'll post the draft in this thread by EOD with examples (launch, POC, named-account).

Lena (Bishop SI): Thanks all 1 we'll stop outreach until confirmed.

Renee P.: Closing after Martin posts the doc and Diego rolls the rule to prod.

crm-bot: Task created: review_handoff_claims for acct_7100, acct_7101, acct_7103, acct_7110. Assignees: partnerships, field. Deadline: 48h.
